title: Digests with only non-RSS sources are completed empty

evidence.quote:
if not feeds:
                logger.warning("No active feeds found")
                digest_logger.pipeline_no_articles(str(self.digest_id), "No active feeds configured")
                await self._complete(0)
                return
# Fetch Wallabag articles (separate from RSS pipeline)
# Pull completed media items for inclusion in digest

reasoning: The pipeline exits immediately when there are no active RSS Feed rows, before it attempts Wallabag, newsletter, or completed media sources. Those sources are explicitly handled independently later in the same method, so a user who only uses newsletters, Wallabag, podcasts, or YouTube will get a completed digest with 0 articles even when configured sources have content.
recommendation: Do not return solely because RSS feeds are empty. Continue through the non-RSS fetch/inclusion paths, and only complete with 0 articles after all enabled sources have been checked.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests cover BinderyPipeline.run with zero active RSS feeds but configured non-RSS sources.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a pipeline test with _get_active_feeds returning [], a configured newsletter or completed MediaItem, and assert the digest includes that non-RSS article instead of completing at 0.
minimumFixScope: BinderyPipeline.run control flow around the early no-feeds branch.
